# Viyana Productions
> Creative Advertising Agency & Cinematic Production Studio

Viyana Productions crafts commercial ad campaigns, cinematic brand films, high-fashion model portfolios, vertical episodic series, OTT web series, and theatrical feature films.

## Core Services & Capabilities
- Commercial Ads & TVC: Full-scale commercial productions, brand films, and multi-platform advertising campaigns.
- Cinematic Content Shoots: Atmospheric visual storytelling with 4K large-format digital cinema workflows.
- Model Portfolio Shoots: High-fashion editorial photography, comp cards, and agency portfolio production.
- Vertical Series: Mobile-first 9:16 cinematic storytelling engineered for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and vertical streaming.
- Web Series & OTT: Scriptwriting, episodic narrative production, and OTT deliverables.
- Short Films & Features: Independent cinema, auteur storytelling, and theatrical distribution packages.
- Graphic Design & Brand Identity: Complete design systems, key visual art, motion graphics, and typography.
- Product Shoots: Studio and lifestyle photography and reels for e-commerce, beauty, luxury, and technology brands.
- Studio Facilities: 4K mastering, ACEScc color grading, sound design, and cinema post-production facility in Bangalore, India.
